segments.name: Diabetes
products: cartridges for insulin storage and delivery
segments.description: Sells the iLet automated insulin dosing system and associated single-use products, distributed to insulin-requiring people with diabetes through distributors and pharmacies.
segments.evidence: As such, the Company has determined that it operates as one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Distributors and pharmacies pay for the iLet and its single-use products, which they then resell to insulin-requiring people with diabetes.
revenueModel.evidence: These products are distributed through a network of distributors and pharmacies, which then resell the products to insulin-requiring PWD.
